about.title: About TrippyGo
about.content:
TrippyGo is a Nepal-focused tourism platform designed to make travel planning easier, faster, and more personalised for domestic and international travellers.

Nepal offers Himalayan trekking routes, cultural heritage sites, wildlife destinations, adventure activities, and peaceful countryside experiences. However, travellers often need to search through several websites to find destination information and organise their journey. TrippyGo brings this information together in one accessible platform.

Users can explore destinations across Nepal, learn about available activities, save favourite places, and generate personalised itineraries based on their interests and travel preferences.

The platform is designed for solo travellers, students, families, couples, and adventure seekers. Its responsive design makes it accessible on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

OUR MISSION

Our mission is to help travellers confidently discover Nepal while promoting its natural beauty, cultural diversity, local communities, and lesser-known destinations.

WHAT TRIPPYGO OFFERS

• Popular and lesser-known destinations across Nepal
• Personalised travel itinerary generation
• Destination search and filtering
• Saved destinations and favourites
• Trekking, cultural, and adventure activities
• Essential destination and travel information
• A simple platform for planning a complete Nepal journey

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.content:
1. What is TrippyGo?

TrippyGo is a tourism and travel-planning platform that helps users discover destinations in Nepal, explore activities, save favourite places, and generate personalised travel itineraries.

2. Do I need an account?

You can browse general destination information without an account. An account is required to save favourites, create itineraries, and access personalised features.

3. How does the itinerary generator work?

The generator uses your selected destination, interests, available time, and travel preferences to suggest a personalised travel plan.

4. Can I change my generated itinerary?

Yes. You can adjust your itinerary according to your schedule, interests, budget, and travel requirements.

5. Can I save destinations for later?

Yes. Logged-in users can add destinations to their favourites and access them later.

6. Does TrippyGo make hotel or flight bookings?

TrippyGo mainly provides destination information and travel-planning tools. Unless a booking option is displayed, reservations must be completed through the relevant provider.

7. Is the travel information always accurate?

We aim to provide current information. However, prices, opening hours, permits, road conditions, and weather can change. Confirm critical details before travelling.

8. Is TrippyGo free?

The main destination-exploration and itinerary-planning features are free unless a feature is clearly identified as paid.

9. Can international travellers use TrippyGo?

Yes. TrippyGo is designed for domestic and international travellers.

10. How can I contact TrippyGo?

Select Contact Support from the footer to view our contact information.

contact.title: Contact Support
contact.content:

insurance.title: Travel Insurance
insurance.content:
Travel insurance can provide financial protection when unexpected problems affect your journey.

CONSIDER COVERAGE FOR

• Emergency medical treatment
• Emergency evacuation and rescue
• Trip cancellation or interruption
• Lost, stolen, or delayed baggage
• Flight delays and missed connections
• Trekking and adventure activities

Standard policies may exclude high-altitude trekking, mountaineering, rafting, paragliding, and other adventure activities. Confirm that your planned activities and maximum altitude are covered.

TrippyGo does not currently sell insurance. Purchase suitable coverage directly from a licensed insurance provider.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content:
TrippyGo respects your privacy privacy and collects only the information required to operate and improve the platform.

INFORMATION WE MAY COLLECT

• Name and email address
• Account and profile information
• Saved destinations and itinerary preferences
• Basic technical and usage information
• Messages submitted to customer support

HOW INFORMATION IS USED

• To create and manage user accounts
• To provide personalised travel features
• To save favourites and itineraries
• To respond to support requests
• To maintain and improve the platform

TrippyGo does not sell users’ personal information. Reasonable measures are used to protect stored information, although no online system can guarantee absolute security.

Users can contact support to request access to, correction of, or deletion of their account information.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.content:

ACCEPTABLE USE

TRAVEL INFORMATION
